sources.title: Git sync
sources.description: Fetch processes, dashboards, monitors and record types from Git repositories. Nothing is applied automatically: every change waits in Updates from Git for a review.
sources.emptyHint: Git sync is off until you add a source. Steward only reads from the repository; changes go to the Updates from Git inbox.
sources.readOnly: Only administrators can manage Git sync sources.
sources.fetched: Fetched {{commit}}: {{staged}} staged for review, {{invalid}} invalid, {{unchanged}} unchanged
sources.deleteConfirm: Delete the source "{{name}}"? Open updates from it are dropped. Items it brought in stay, but lose their Git origin.
sources.rotateConfirm: Create a new webhook secret? The old one stops working right away – update the webhook on the Git host.
sources.settingsCard: Fetch processes, dashboards, monitors and record types from Forgejo, GitHub or GitLab. Off until you add a source.

form.name: Name
form.repoUrlHint: The web address of the repository, e.g. https://git.example.com/team/steward-library
form.apiUrlHint: Only when the API is not at the usual place (GitHub Enterprise, GitLab under a sub-path)
form.folderHint: Only files below this folder are read (empty = whole repository)
form.tokenHint: Read-only access to the repository contents. Stored encrypted in the vault, never shown again. Empty for public repositories.
form.tokenKeep: A token is stored – leave empty to keep it
form.intervalHint: 0 = no schedule (fetch by hand or by webhook). At least 5 minutes.
form.webhookHint: The Git host calls Steward on every push. Needs Steward to be reachable from the Git host.
form.requireSignedHint: Fetches fail unless the Git host verified the signature of the branch's head commit.
form.autoAcceptHint: Items that do not exist in Steward yet are created right away (monitors disabled). Changes to existing items still need a review.

secret.title: Webhook secret
secret.text: Copy the secret now – it is shown only once. Set up the webhook on the Git host:
secret.hint: Content type application/json, push events only. GitHub and Forgejo sign the payload with the secret; GitLab sends it as the secret token.

updates.title: Updates from Git
updates.description: Changes fetched from Git sync sources. Review each one and accept it (a new version) or reject it.
updates.emptyHint: New or changed files in a Git sync source appear here after a fetch.
updates.noAccess: Only designers and administrators review updates from Git.

detail.title: Update: {{name}}
detail.noChanges: The incoming file is the same as the item in Steward.
detail.newItem: This item does not exist in Steward yet. Accepting creates it.
detail.conflictTitle: Conflict with the item in Steward
detail.conflictText: {{reason}}. Accepting overwrites it with the version from Git (for processes as a new version – the old one stays in the history).
detail.cannotDecide: You may view this update, but not decide it (it needs the right to create or edit this item).

conflictReasons.notFromGit: The item exists in Steward but did not come from this source
conflictReasons.changedLocally: The item was changed in Steward since it was last synced
